coverageRationale.en: Rewrites ISO/IEC 11770-3:2021 as a reproducible structure: 15 key-agreement, 6 secret-key-transport and 3 public-key-transport mechanisms, with finite-field, elliptic-curve and pairing formulas, KDF, commitment and confirmation; the 2025 TFNS amendment is counted separately.

zh.principle: **标准**：非对称技术密钥管理（Key management — Part 3: Mechanisms using asymmetric techniques）。ISO/IEC 11770-3:2021 把非对称密钥管理分成三类：15 个密钥协商（KA）、6 个私钥传输（SKT）、3 个公钥传输（PKT），共 24 个机制。密钥协商让双方交换数据后共同计算共享值 F，任何一方不能预先决定结果；私钥传输由 A 选定 K_AB，用 B 的公钥封装后传给 B；公钥传输只认证公钥，不要求保密。数学覆盖有限域、椭圆曲线与双线性对。有限域用 F=g^{r_A r_B} mod p；椭圆曲线用 F=[r_A r_B]G，若曲线有 cofactor h 还要算 hF；配对机制用 e([r_A]P,[r_B]Q)。F 不是会话密钥，必须经 KDF 绑定双方身份、随机数、TVP 与 SID 才能得到 K。标准还讨论 key confirmation（用 MAC 证明持有同一 K）与 key commitment（用 H(K||nonce) 防止未知密钥共享）。2025 年补篇加入 TFNS 标识密钥协商，但 2021 正文的 24 个机制不变。公式化记法：K=KDF(F, context)，context=(I_A,I_B,R_A,R_B,SID,purpose)。上下文缺一项，协议就可能跨会话复用或遭未知密钥共享。
zh.why: 三种机制不是同义词。密钥协商的安全性依赖双方私钥与交换消息，任何一方不能预定 K；私钥传输的安全性依赖 B 的公钥与解密能力，A 能选 K 但 B 必须信任封装；公钥传输只解决“这把公钥属于谁”，不解决机密性。KDF 不是可选装饰：原始 F 可能有偏差或不是均匀随机，直接当密钥会留下分布问题；把身份和 TVP 绑进 KDF，才能阻止未知密钥共享与跨会话重放。EC 的 cofactor 乘法用于把点落到正确子群，漏掉会让小子群攻击有机可乘。公式级价值在于说清“哪一类机制、哪一个群运算、哪一层绑定”，而不是把 24 个机制压成“非对称密钥交换”。
zh.used: 选型：双方都要参与计算且不能预定 K，选 KA；A 要控制密钥值，选 SKT；只需认证公钥归属，选 PKT。再选群：有限域、椭圆曲线或配对；配对机制还要检查 PKG/可信中心与密钥托管。实现顺序：校验域参数与公钥；生成私钥并计算公钥；交换/封装；计算 F；EC 乘 cofactor；KDF 绑定 I_A/I_B/TVP/SID/purpose；做 key confirmation；需要时做 key commitment。工程检查：RNG 是否合格；私钥是否在受保护环境；公钥证书链是否验证；KDF 是否用标准函数；是否把 F 直接当密钥；是否漏 cofactor；是否只做单向确认；是否记录 SID 与用途。
zh.broken: 标准不覆盖密钥生命周期、密钥对生成/校验、存储/归档/销毁，也不规定具体变换。它不保证实现安全；侧信道、错误注入、RNG 失败都在标准之外。未认证的 DH 会遭中间人；EC 漏 cofactor 会遭小群攻击；KDF 不绑身份/TVP 会遭未知密钥共享；只做单向确认或不做承诺，可能让一方接受未知密钥。配对机制还要面对 PKG 托管与配对参数选择。2025 TFNS 补篇是新增机制，不是 2021 正文的修订；引用时不要把 24 个变成 25 个而不说明版本。
zh.history:
Part 3 于 1999 年首版，2008 年第二版，2015 年第三版；2017 年 Amd 1 加入 blinded Diffie-Hellman，2021 年第四版把它纳入正文并给出 90 页的 24 个机制；2025 年 4 月 Amd 1 加 TFNS 标识密钥协商。

**技术参数与复算边界**

该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：非对称技术密钥管理的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 非对称技术密钥管理 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。

复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。

en.principle: **Standard**: Key management — Part 3: Mechanisms using asymmetric techniques (非对称技术密钥管理). ISO/IEC 11770-3:2021 divides asymmetric key management into three classes: 15 key-agreement (KA), 6 secret-key-transport (SKT) and 3 public-key-transport (PKT) mechanisms, 24 in total. Key agreement has both parties exchange data and jointly compute a shared value F that neither can predetermine; secret-key transport has A choose K_AB and encapsulate it under B’s public key; public-key transport authenticates a public key without requiring secrecy. The mathematics covers finite fields, elliptic curves and bilinear pairings. A finite field uses F=g^{r_A r_B} mod p; an elliptic curve uses F=[r_A r_B]G, multiplied by cofactor h when the curve has one; pairing mechanisms use e([r_A]P,[r_B]Q). F is not the session key: it must pass through a KDF bound to identities, random numbers, TVPs and SID to produce K. The standard also discusses key confirmation (a MAC proving possession of the same K) and key commitment (H(K||nonce) to resist unknown-key sharing). The 2025 amendment adds TFNS identity-based key agreement, while the 24 mechanisms of the 2021 body remain unchanged. A compact notation is K=KDF(F, context), with context=(I_A,I_B,R_A,R_B,SID,purpose). If one context field is missing, the protocol may reuse a key across sessions or accept unknown-key sharing.
en.why:
The three mechanisms are not synonyms. Key agreement depends on both private keys and the exchanged messages, and neither party can predetermine K; secret-key transport depends on B’s public key and decryption capability, so A can choose K but B must trust the encapsulation; public-key transport only answers “who owns this public key” and does not provide confidentiality.

A KDF is not decoration: raw F may be biased or not uniformly random, and using it directly as a key leaves distribution problems; binding identities and TVPs into the KDF blocks unknown-key sharing and cross-session replay. EC cofactor multiplication maps the point into the correct subgroup; omitting it opens small-subgroup attacks.

The formula-level value is stating which mechanism class, which group operation and which binding layer are used, not collapsing 24 mechanisms into “asymmetric key exchange”.
en.used:
Selection: use KA when both parties must contribute and neither may predetermine K; use SKT when A must control the key value; use PKT when only public-key ownership needs authentication. Then choose the group: finite field, elliptic curve or pairing; pairing mechanisms also require checking the PKG/trusted centre and key escrow.

Implementation order: validate domain parameters and public keys; generate the private key and compute the public key; exchange or encapsulate; compute F; multiply by the EC cofactor; run the KDF with I_A/I_B/TVP/SID/purpose; perform key confirmation; add key commitment when needed.

Engineering checks: is the RNG fit for purpose; is the private key in a protected environment; is the certificate chain verified; is the KDF a standard one; is F used directly as a key; is the cofactor missing; is confirmation one-way only; are SID and purpose recorded.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken:
The standard does not cover key life cycle, key-pair generation/validation, storage, archiving or destruction, and does not specify transformations. It does not guarantee implementation security; side channels, fault injection and RNG failure are outside it.

Unauthenticated DH is exposed to man-in-the-middle; an EC implementation that omits the cofactor is exposed to small-subgroup attacks; a KDF without identity/TVP binding is exposed to unknown-key sharing; one-way confirmation or no commitment can let one party accept an unknown key. Pairing mechanisms also face PKG escrow and pairing-parameter choices.

The 2025 TFNS amendment is an added mechanism, not a revision of the 2021 body; do not turn 24 into 25 without stating the version.
en.history: Part 3 appeared in 1999, was revised in 2008 and 2015; Amd 1:2017 added blinded Diffie-Hellman, which the 2021 fourth edition folded into the 90-page body with 24 mechanisms; Amd 1:2025, published in April 2025, added TFNS identity-based key agreement.
